name: Alert
description: A message tinted in its status.

status.description: Required: a block that forgot to say should not render red.

icon.description: A name from the icon list. Defaults to the status's own.

isLive.description: Announced when it appears. On for danger unless set.

isDismissible.description: A close button; the block hides itself and fires onClose.

actions.description: A Button or a LinkButton, or a Stack of them.
